cases.name: real-narratives-person-86-FOOTBALL
cases.reading:
OneFootball, Yardbarker, and Yahoo report that RB Leipzig coach Martín Demichelis has praised Yan Diomande ahead of the Champions League clash between Real Madrid and Leipzig at the Bernabéu.

Goal.com reports that Martín Demichelis insists Franco Mastantuono is built for Real Madrid despite his loan spell at Fiorentina, noting the player needs time.
